result:
Round 14 passes: all six fix acceptance IDs (R14-P1, P2, S, E, U, Doc), the adjacent regression checks and gates G14-1..3 passed. The round-13 repros for C-R13-01, C-R13-02 and C-R13-03 no longer reproduce on this tree. I found two new bugs for B. I changed no app source and made no commits.

**Gates (I re-ran them)**
- **G14-1:** vitest 945/945 across 55 files, and 96/96 in the three round-14 test files. tsc 0, Biome 0 errors (218 old warnings, same as round 13), build passes.
- **G14-2:** the 35 frozen files match B's hashes, including the dock and `Modal.tsx`. Only the 7 files A owned changed, and A's backups match B's hashes. Header and protected files are unchanged; the work tree was the same at start and end.
- **G14-3:** I used a fresh browser with no credentials. Opening `/studio-lab` directly and through the header link made no token, download or R2 requests, and media came only from the two demo MP3s and `blob:`. The token endpoint returned 401 anonymously; a fake Bearer got a 500 and no token. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required", so premium access is not bypassed.

**Browser checks (real clicks and keys, 1440├ù900 and 1280├ù720)**
- **Placement (R14-P1):** in all six cases the box matched the D-29e formula within 0.02 px and sat inside the library body. The collapse button, search, separator and preview toggle stayed clickable. A real click on the collapse button returned the video with its message word for word. The 160 px minimum case was never reached.
- **Find ΓåÆ add (R14-P2, 1440):** search, filter and Enter added exactly one clip with one Undo entry. The box did not move and stayed expanded.
- **Return messages (R14-S):** all return paths show the new messages word for word. Esc with nothing expanded, and reopening the library with no expanded video, write nothing.
- **Export focus (R14-E):** the original round-13 repro now works (Enter closes the dialog and the video stays expanded). Tab and Shift+Tab wrap inside the dialog, Space does not touch playback, and Esc returns focus to where it was.
- **WAV:** exported entirely by keyboard. It is valid PCM, stereo, 48 kHz, 24-bit, 288 384 frames = 6.008 s, which equals the project end. Each section has real audio at the expected level.
- **Unit tests (R14-U):** I reproduced A's four required test-breaking changes in a throwaway copy of the code, never in source. Each made the expected tests fail.
- **Adjacent checks:** dragging, the arrow nudges, re-fitting after a resize, ignoring a second pointer, keeping the same video elements, placing after the library's width animation, the reduced-motion simulation, preview audio stopping on collapse (measured 0.11 ΓåÆ 0), and the dock sizes all match round 13.

**New bugs for B**
- **C-R14-01 (Medium):** the expanded box covers the lower library rows, and they can't be scrolled out from under it.
  - At 1280├ù720 with the library at 480, every result row and every tree node is covered at any scroll position. A real click on a search result fails and no clip is added. Keyboard (ArrowDown + Enter) still works.
  - At 1440├ù900 with the library at 288, the last two rows stay covered even when the list is fully scrolled.
  - This comes from B's D-29e placement rule, not from A's code. R14-P2 is only required at 1440, so it doesn't fail this round.
- **C-R14-02 (Low):** if focus lands on the dialog's own Γ£ò (the close button inside the shared Modal), Shift+Tab leaves the dialog. Enter then toggles the workspace detail panel behind the open dialog. Keyboard focus can't reach that button from inside the dialog. A described this gap; I confirmed it causes real actions behind the dialog.

**Not verified**
- Real `prefers-reduced-motion`: the browser tool blocks emulating it, so I only ran a simulation. This stays with the Tech Lead.
- Focus during a WAV render: the render finished in under 120 ms, so I couldn't sample focus mid-render in the browser. Only a unit test and one of A's own test-breaking checks cover it.
- My WAV export used this session's 6 s project, not round 13's 16 s project.
- The known clipping at full scale (1018 samples at 0 dBFS) is the existing export hard-clip item (R13-M4), not a new bug.

**Carry items and notes**
- Still open: the hardcoded middle-east purchased loader, smooth scrolling on `/studio/*`, portable instruction paths, the uncommitted tree, and the shared Modal's missing focus handling.
- Root analytics also sends a `scroll` event in consent-denied mode, not only `page_view`. That is outside Studio.

Files are in `C:\Apps\czaba-project\tmp\studio-real-loop\`:
- c-round-14.md
- c-round-14.json
- c-round-14/
